latestVersion.changelog:
Video Letter Maker Free 1.0.0 — initial release

- Create personal video letters from your photos, clips, and audio (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG supported; up to 200MB)
- Cloud-based AI processing delivers 1080p MP4 files in 1–2 minutes
- Free token system (100 credits, 7-day expiry) enables easy access for new users
- Supports editing with voiceovers, background music, and text overlays
- Simple workflows for uploading, editing, and exporting video letters without local installs
- Clear error handling, session management, and helpful usage tips included
